metadata.description: Agent skills from Codemagic: CI/CD for mobile apps, CodePush OTA updates, and self-hosted Codemagic Patch OTA updates.

plugins.name: codemagic-ci-cd
plugins.description: Set up and troubleshoot Codemagic CI/CD for mobile apps: first build, codemagic.yaml, code signing, triggers, caching, testing, publishing and Shorebird.

plugins.name: codemagic-codepush
plugins.description: Set up and run OTA updates for React Native apps with Codemagic-hosted CodePush (codepush.pro).

plugins.name: codemagic-patch
plugins.description: Set up Codemagic Patch self-hosted OTA updates in React Native, Expo, Capacitor and Ionic apps, fitted to how each project is laid out.
